g.text: Facade | How the console uses the same application boundary
Start a lesson: read and confirm one card
A new card becomes studied and due today.
No answer attempt or XP is added.
Final-card completion is saved in the same snapshot.
Practice words: create a session and submit one answer
These are successful-save paths. If saving throws IOException,
the facade does not advance the card or record the answer in the session,
and it does not publish the unsaved progress. The console can retry.
Practice advancement/completion happens separately through nextExercise().
